title: Field Marketing Executive (Experienced)
description:
Role & Responsibilities We are hiring 4 experienced Field Marketing Executives to expand our broadband customer base across Talegaon Dabhade, Maval and nearby areas. Generate new broadband connections through field sales and direct marketing. Visit residential societies, apartments, shops, offices and commercial establishments. Conduct door-to-door campaigns and promote fiber broadband plans. Build relationships with society committees, builders and local businesses. Generate leads, follow up with potential customers and convert enquiries into paid connections. Identify competitor activities and new business opportunities. Achieve monthly sales, customer acquisition and revenue targets. Maintain daily field visit, lead generation and sales reports. Coordinate with technical teams for timely installation and activation. Preferred Candidate Profile Minimum 1 year of experience in field sales or marketing. ISP / Broadband / Telecom sales experience strongly preferred. Good communication, negotiation and customer-handling skills. Experience in door-to-door sales, lead generation and customer acquisition. Knowledge of Talegaon Dabhade, Maval and surrounding areas preferred. Self-motivated, target-oriented and comfortable working in the field. Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred. 12th pass or graduate. Perks & Benefits Fixed salary based on experience and skills. Attractive performance-based sales incentives. Growth opportunities within the company. Training and support from the technical and sales teams. Opportunity to build a long-term career in the broadband industry. Company: InfinityLink Communications Pvt. Ltd. (BS Networks Broadband) Job Location: Limb Fata, Talegaon Dabhade, Pune Job Type: Full-time, Permanent Openings: 4

Key Skills: Content,Marketing,Radio,Television,Development,Ott,Sales administration,Coordination
